title: Dubai vs Singapore: Which City Should You Visit?
description: A data-backed comparison of Dubai and Singapore based on Reddit discussions, real costs, food scenes, and traveler preferences.

categories.summary: Singapore has one of the greatest food cultures on Earth, and the hawker centre system is its crowning achievement. faqs.question: Is Dubai or Singapore cheaper?
faqs.answer: Singapore is generally cheaper for day-to-day costs thanks to its hawker centre system — a full meal costs $2–5 SGD ($1.50–4 USD) at any of 100+ government-run food centres. faqs.question: Is Dubai safe for tourists?
faqs.answer: Yes, Dubai is one of the world's safest cities for tourists. The UAE has extremely strict laws and low violent crime. faqs.answer: Dubai's best months are November through March — temperatures drop to a pleasant 20–28°C, perfect for outdoor activities and desert safaris. faqs.answer: Singapore wins on food culture depth and value. faqs.answer: Dubai: 3–4 days covers the main highlights — Burj Khalifa, gold souk, Dubai Museum, Jumeirah Beach, a desert safari. faqs.answer: Yes, but only in licensed venues — hotels, airport, designated restaurants and bars. You cannot drink on the street, in public, or in a non-licensed restaurant.
